instruction: Enable blockchain-based document verification to create an immutable timestamp and proof of authorship for this document.

metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer does not have blockchain integration or cryptographic document verification features. While digital signatures can be added, blockchain-based immutable timestamp and proof of authorship systems are not supported.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible because blockchain-based document verification is not supported in LibreOffice Writer
The infeasible() evaluator function is the appropriate handler for impossible tasks that cannot be completed due to technical limitations
Metadata provides clear explanation of why the task is infeasible (no blockchain integration or cryptographic document verification features)
No verification logic is needed for infeasible tasks - the evaluator correctly reflects that the instruction cannot be completed
